title: Independent forestry harvest and later planting without an upfront seed kit
assumptions: Both PHYSICAL and VIRTUAL native player/Auto inventories share this policy; closed legacy Auto and accepted paid forestry jobs retain their historical replant terms. New native trees without a matching sapling use the existing persisted thinning representation: no immediate replant debit, roots become AIR, later planting remains paid and separately journaled.

Before, a no-kit native worker harvested zero trees. After, native drop tables/tools remain unchanged; there is no extra roll and no synthetic log or seed issuance. Scenario is one existing small oak/minute with exactly three observed logs and zero modeled leaf drop: 0.25/1/4 active hours/day =>15/60/240 trees/day,1/10/16 native cities. Leaf drops are unknown rather than asserted zero globally; unchanged native loot remains outside this illustrative three-log lower-dimensional scenario.

Examples do not predict mature tree supply, travel, growth, pauses, bags or actual tool durability. Natural trees are finite and removed; repeat income needs new natural growth or paid planting. New tree sessions are at least6seconds; even before native multi-batch scans, tools and storage the loose session ceiling is600trees/hour. An item upper bound is not derived from that because actual species/crown/drop/fortune differs.

With an already funded kit, the existing one-or-four-sapling cost and final replant are unchanged. A no-kit harvest has0seed debit both before(stalled) and after(harvest first); later planting costs1or4real saplings once. Existing paid receipts are not rewritten, replay cannot emit a second native drop set, and physical blocks are consumed once.

No direct Vault,tokens,player XP,price,boost or recipe-rate change. Current SELL/AutoSell can convert native items downstream; no verified quote is available, no exchange rate or accumulation time is invented. Planned SELL-to-contract transition remains a separate future flow. Privileged Auto supply extraction gates remain unchanged.

Builder preload shares the existing global maximum512native items/second across the backend. Material quantities come only from the remaining exact accepted bill; bags, local stock,incoming and reachable surplus subtract them. Courier changes move existing items only; no reward for transfer. No new monetary mint or item duplication path is added.

flows.basis: Illustrative no-kit stand of existing three-log oaks; one tree/minute, not a measured rate or maximum
